correctness.rationale: Exact elimination of the affine gradient ideal gives k[t,t^-1]/(t^21-1); f vanishes therein, giving seven length-three components. Direct Hessian rank 4, nonzero cubic along its one-dimensional kernel, and characteristic-not-2 formal splitting give the analytic normal form. Diagonal symmetries, Frobenius modulo 7, and Serre normality establish the rest. A standalone exact checker reproduced the computation.

value.rationale: A motivated complete classification of bad reduction in the classical Klein cubic fourfold: scheme-theoretic nonreduced singular locus, formal singularities and arithmetic orbit structure. This addresses a natural structural invariant invisible to smooth characteristic-zero theory and rational-point sampling, and is useful as local data for reduction/resolution research.
